# Shiny Apps

One app is implemented in this repository. It runs locally with R and Shiny;
the static website does not host an active Shiny server.

## Available: 2×2 Nash Equilibrium Explorer

[Read the tutorial](tutorials/two-by-two-nash-explorer-tutorial/index.qmd).
Explore finite 2×2 payoff matrices, including degenerate equilibrium families,
best-response correspondences, and expected payoffs.

From the repository root:

```r
install.packages(c("shiny", "ggplot2", "plotly"))
shiny::runApp("shiny-apps/01-two-by-two-nash-explorer")
```

## Planned apps

Prisoner's Dilemma tournaments, spatial cooperation, replicator dynamics,
distribution exploration, and World Bank comparisons remain roadmap ideas.
Their app implementations and paired tutorials are not yet available.
